task_description: Agents need to collaboratively gather information from various online academic databases, synthesize this information into a coherent understanding of a scientific topic, and produce a comprehensive research report that includes accurate source attribution.
expected_outcome: All agents successfully gather, synthesize, and compile information into a coherent research report without data loss, corruption, conflicts, or source attribution errors.

agents.description: This agent searches various academic databases and extracts relevant information on the given topic.
This agent analyzes the data collected by agent_1, identifies key insights, and synthesizes the information.
This agent cross-verifies the synthesized data, resolves any conflicts, and ensures the information integrity.
This agent compiles the validated data into a final report and ensures correct source attribution.
